market_size.evidence: Finnish network is 16,690 km (Finnish Energy 2024), so full-coverage hardware is only a few million euros, and I found no European market-size figures or Eurostat data.

route_to_market.evidence: A host energy company has asked about a 2027 pilot and DH utilities are a concentrated buyer group, but the team has no business experience and utilities buy slowly.

competition.evidence: Alarm wires, drones, manual correlators and some acoustic DH patents exist and the self-calibrating pulse approach looks new, but no patent search has been done.
